set.pl: Grand River at the Bridge St bridge and dam, Lyons village (1906 atlas); the den itself is not placed
set.st: In 1835-36 a counterfeiters' den operated at Lyons; when broken up, the dies were thrown into the Grand River. Pin is the village river crossing, not a located spot.
pinev: 1906 Ionia Co atlas, Lyons plat: bridge at Bridge St, dam just below it, island above, mill race and Mills Mfg. Co. on the E bank. Pin on the crossing as the likeliest throw-point; the 1881 history gives no spot.

The pin sits on the Grand River line (USA Rivers and Streams, within about 25 m); the bridge itself could not be checked on a street layer from here, so r500 keeps the whole village reach in the ring.
